name: Titanium.UI.iOS.ListViewCellSelectionStyle
summary:
A set of constants for the style that can be used for the `selectionStyle` property of a
ListItem, which is set in the `properties` dictionary of either the [ListDataItem](api:ListDataItem) or
[ItemTemplate](api:ItemTemplate).

properties.name: BLUE
properties.summary: The cell when selected has a blue background. This is the default value.

properties.name: GRAY
properties.summary: The cell when selected has a gray background.

properties.name: NONE
properties.summary: The cell has no distinct style for when it is selected.
